summary.pause_policy: Raw seconds preserved. Logged suspension removed only for the identified training/evaluation phase, using checkpoint/CSV publication timestamps. These remain shared-host wall times, not isolated CPU speed estimates.

report_verification.counting_rule: Excludes table and longtable contents and figure captions; includes headings, inline mathematics/numbers and conservative title allowance.
report_verification.human_review: Completed using member rankings, final group priorities, rationale and broad support supplied by the user.

scope: Derived compact evidence; raw episode logs, models and ten analyzed full traces accompany the ZIP. Human review includes user-supplied initial rankings, group priorities, rationale and broad support.
